Release Bot: Weekly release ops bulletin: freeze starts Fri 08:00 UTC -> Mon 08:00 UTC. Minimal exceptions. :bell:
Kai Turner: Quick q: does this block scheduled model refreshes that touch production embeddings?
Release Bot: Model refreshes that write to prod embeddings are blocked unless they are backwards-compatible snapshots. Non-prod refreshes OK. For prod exceptions, provide risk / rollback and get @Ops sign-off.
Nina Shah: Canary update: inference-runtime v3.16 at 3% in us-west. p50 stable, p95 had a small spike around 02:10 UTC. Investigating whether it's related to batcher backpressure.
Riley Chen: PR #4321 includes a health-check addition and an automated rollback helper. If canary crosses error threshold, run `./ops rollback --train inference-runtime` and @Ops will be paged.
Ops: Reminder: to request a freeze exemption, open an RFC in /rfc/release-exceptions and tag the approver GitHub handle plus a 1-line justification and rollback.
Alex Kim: We'll delay the console client rollout until after the freeze window to reduce blast radius.
Release Bot: TL;DR: freeze Fri 08:00 UTC -> Mon 08:00 UTC. Canaries allowed but DO NOT increase percentages or widen rings without explicit approver. Post any exception requests in this thread.
